name: Metamagic Rod, Thanatopic
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser thanatopic metamagic rod 9,000 gp
Thanatopic metamagic rod 32,500 gp
Greater thanatopic metamagic rod 73,000 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that are affected as though using the Thanatopic Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Thanatopic Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser thanatopic metamagic rod 4,500 gp
Thanatopic metamagic rod 16,250 gp
Greater thanatopic metamagic rod 36,500 gp
